programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''from collections import deque

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    components = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            comp = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                comp.append((y, x, grid[y][x]))
                for dy, dx in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):
                    ny, nx = y + dy, x + dx
                    if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and grid[ny][nx] != 0 and (ny, nx) not in seen:
                        seen.add((ny, nx))
                        q.append((ny, nx))
            components.append(comp)
    source = next(comp for comp in components if len(comp) > 1 and any(v == 5 for _, _, v in comp))
    marker = next((r, c) for comp in components if len(comp) == 1 for r, c, v in comp if v == 5)
    anchor = next((r, c) for r, c, v in source if v == 5)
    dr, dc = marker[0] - anchor[0], marker[1] - anchor[1]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    out[marker[0]][marker[1]] = 0
    for r, c, v in source:
        nr, nc = r + dr, c + dc
        if v != 5 and 0 <= nr < h and 0 <= nc < w:
            out[nr][nc] = v
    return out
'''
